fact: The Plan sectoriel de l'éducation 2022-2030, presented to the Conseil des Ministres on 15 March 2023, states under 'Renforcement du SIGE' that the basic statistical aspects are covered at present, that a global diagnostic of the SIGE will be undertaken, and that the medium-term objective is a global SIGE integrating infrastructure, evaluations, human resources management and the registration of schools and of individual pupils (immatriculation des écoles et individuelle des élèves).
title: Plan sectoriel de l'éducation 2022-2030
